verdict.rationale: Open-protocol access and standards-based export are fair questions for an email client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, or mbox/EML export. Zero connects to Gmail/Outlook (Gmail via Google OAuth), and its only API-like surface is a cookie-authenticated MCP capability list; self-hosting and open source are adjacent features, not protocol access or export.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
